## Endpoints

### Data Read (4)
- `GET /api/v2/area-data/human-created-content` — Get human-created content related to areas.
- `GET /api/v2/discovery/koti` — Discover properties for sale or rent.
- `GET /api/v2/loans/banks/announcement` — Get announcements related to loan banks.
- `GET /wrapper/v2/{v2Id}` — Retrieve detailed property information by ID.

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /api/v2/spotlight` — Submit spotlight data for a property.
- `POST /api/v2/view-persist/announcement` — Record a view of an announcement.
- `POST /wrapper/v2/pv-data` — Submit property view data.

### Search (1)
- `POST /api/v2/poi/nearest` — Find points of interest near a location.

### Config (2)
- `GET /ats-etuovi/latest/ats-manifest.json` — Get configuration for the ATS integration.
- `GET /consent/tcfv2/vendor-list/categories` — Get vendor list categories for consent management.

### Core API (1)
- `GET /api/v3/firstparty` — Access core API functionalities.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Etuovi's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**

- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:

- Automate actions on www.etuovi.com (faster than browser automation)
